title: Size of a brass band and a bop trumpeter on Sweet Georgia Brown
summary: Punch says brass bands used eight to ten pieces and recalls a young bop player struggling with Sweet Georgia Brown.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: they played nice too. How big a brass band would they use in those days?

Ten pieces, that's the most ten pieces. Ten, eight. They used some short bands in them. Oh yeah, we'd have like two trumpets, two trombones, that's four, two drums, that's six, a crown at seven, and tuba be eight. And if they use any more, it'd be an alto and another trumpet. I caught a little bop from a young captain on the road with a show playing bop and played Sweet Georgia Brown and we was taking the straight lead of it and he's playing the bop. And that's the idea he was giving up. What's he doing?
Now he still was playing Georgia Brown, but he was sitting there saying da they said da didn't go to the other part, the same thing you know what I mean.
